summary: An 80-foot steel lookout on SC Highway 64 in Barnwell, dated to 1935; fire observation ended in 1993 and it now serves as a radio repeater site.

facts.design: Steel tower, appears to be an Aermotor LS-40 (per register), with a 10 x 7 x 7 ft steel cab

access.note: Lowest steps removed to discourage climbing; the tower now carries a radio repeater.

events.note: Register says about 1935 and SC Picture Project says 1935; a December 1935 paper still lists tower construction as pending
CCC enrollees repainted the living quarters at the tower site (1938-39)
Fire observation ended statewide; tower decommissioned as a fire tower and now a radio repeater site

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Not fully resolved. The register and SC Picture Project say 1935. The People-Sentinel of 5 December 1935 still listed tower construction as pending, and the 24 December 1936 issue reports three towers built. That paper does not name the register's tower.

notes_for_editor: The 1936 paper lists three towers (Reynolds station, Barnwell near the Charleston highway, and Dunbarton) but does not name the register's tower, so linking it is an inference. Register and SC Picture coordinates differ by about 40 m; the record keeps the NHLR point. Post and Courier statewide articles returned HTTP 429 and were not read. The 1938-39 CCC detail is quoted on the Eastern US Lookouts page from a 1939 state report; I did not read that report directly.
